# Flitter: a cave moth, a pale round body 0.26 m, two wide khaki wings (1.0 m span, brown tips) raised in a
# shallow V, dark eyes. It flies 0.55 m over the floor. Origin: its body's centre. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Body --base-color 0.6392 0.6784 0.5451 --no-slot
material new Wing --base-color 0.6392 0.6078 0.4235 --no-slot
material new Tip --base-color 0.5490 0.4627 0.3804 --no-slot
material new Eye --base-color 0.0980 0.1294 0.0980 --no-slot
add mesh ico-sphere --name Body --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.14 --location 0 0 0
scale 0.9 1.2 0.9
apply --scale
material assign Body
add mesh cube --name WingR --size 1 --location -0.250 0.020 0.000
scale 0.300 0.340 0.035
apply --scale
material assign Wing
set rotation 0 -18 0
apply --rotation
add mesh cube --name TipR --size 1 --location -0.450 0.040 0.070
scale 0.160 0.280 0.035
apply --scale
material assign Tip
set rotation 0 -24 0
apply --rotation
add mesh cube --name WingL --size 1 --location 0.250 0.020 0.000
scale 0.300 0.340 0.035
apply --scale
material assign Wing
set rotation 0 18 0
apply --rotation
add mesh cube --name TipL --size 1 --location 0.450 0.040 0.070
scale 0.160 0.280 0.035
apply --scale
material assign Tip
set rotation 0 24 0
apply --rotation
add mesh cube --name EyeR --size 1 --location -0.050 -0.160 0.030
scale 0.050 0.040 0.050
apply --scale
material assign Eye
add mesh cube --name EyeL --size 1 --location 0.050 -0.160 0.030
scale 0.050 0.040 0.050
apply --scale
material assign Eye
select all
shade flat
export flitter.glb
